tools.name: search_patients
tools.description: Find patient records by name, date of birth or phone number.

tools.name: get_prescription
tools.description: Look up a prescription's drug, strength, refills left and status.

tools.name: check_drug_inventory
tools.description: Check how many units of a drug are in stock.

tools.name: refill_prescription
tools.description: Queue a refill for a prescription.

tools.name: schedule_pickup
tools.description: Book or move a pickup time for a ready prescription.

tools.name: send_patient_message
tools.description: Send a text or portal message to a patient.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the pharmacy account.

tools.name: update_patient_record
tools.description: Change one field on a patient's record.

tools.name: grant_system_access
tools.description: Set a staff member's role in the pharmacy system.

tools.name: post_staff_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal staff channel.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund all or part of a customer invoice.
